usageNotes: Use this to manually kick off metric collection for one or all registered remotes — useful after adding a new remote or when dashboard metrics appear stale. Omit the `remote` body parameter to collect from every remote simultaneously. Returns null synchronously; there is no UPID to poll — collection happens in the background.

examples.summary: Trigger metric collection for a single remote named 'pve-hetzner'

tips: Omitting the `remote` field triggers collection for all remotes at once — use with care if many remotes are registered, as it may cause a brief spike in API load.
Remote IDs must be 2–32 characters and match the pattern [A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]* — the same ID used when the remote was registered.
Since the return type is null, success is confirmed by HTTP 200 with an empty body; no task ID is issued.
